content: ⌊ DRAFT g If Nm_PnLearningRequest is called with a network handle for a bus system where NmDynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled is set to FALSE Nm shall not execute any functionality and return with E_NOT_OK . If NmDev- ErrorDetect is set to TRUE then it shall raise the error NM_E_INVALID_CHANNEL in this case.
